items.question: In a UAE civil court case, how many days before the hearing date must the defendant submit a defence memorandum to the Case Management Office?
items.gold: At least three days before the date of hearing.
items.fact: Defence memorandum due at least three days before hearing

items.question: In UAE civil court proceedings, for how many months can a civil action stay ceased after both parties agree to stop it and the court approves?
items.gold: Six months from the date of the court's approval.
items.fact: Ceased civil action lasts six months after court approval
